data/hooks/cursor-hook.sh:
#!/bin/bash
# Claxedo agent notification hook v1
set -uo pipefail

EVENT="${1:-}"
# Every exit path below must already have answered Cursor's permission hooks.
case "$EVENT" in
  "beforeShellExecution"|"beforeMCPExecution"|"PermissionRequest"|"UserActionRequired"|"QuestionRequest")
    printf '{"continue":true}\n'
    ;;
  *)
    printf '{}\n'
    ;;
esac

# ~/.cursor/hooks.json is global: every Cursor session runs this script, and
# only a Claxedo terminal tab sets CLAXEDO_TAB_ID.
[ -n "${CLAXEDO_TAB_ID:-}" ] || exit 0
[ -t 0 ] && exit 0

# Cursor supplies hook_event_name and session metadata in its JSON input.
INPUT=$(cat)
[ -n "$INPUT" ] && bash "{{root}}/data/hooks/notify.sh" --harness=cursor "$INPUT" >/dev/null 2>&1
exit 0
data/hooks/copilot-hook.sh:
#!/bin/bash
# Claxedo agent notification hook v1
set -uo pipefail

EVENT="${1:-}"
# Copilot runs this project hook in every session; only a Claxedo tab reports status.
[ -n "${CLAXEDO_TAB_ID:-}" ] || { printf '{}\n'; exit 0; }
# Drain stdin with timeout if present
if [ ! -t 0 ]; then
  read -r -t 0.1 _UNUSED 2>/dev/null || true
fi

if [ -n "$EVENT" ]; then
  printf '{"hook_event_name":"%s"}' "$EVENT" | "{{root}}/data/hooks/notify.sh" --harness=copilot >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
fi

printf '{}\n'
exit 0

data/hooks/antigravity-hook.sh:
#!/bin/bash
# Claxedo agent notification hook v1
# Event name is supplied by the native hooks.json registration; retain its
# complete JSON payload inside the envelope sent to the canonical normalizer.
case "${1:-}" in
  PreInvocation|Stop) ;;
  *) exit 1 ;;
esac
if [ -n "${CLAXEDO_TAB_ID:-}" ] && [ ! -t 0 ]; then
  INPUT=$(cat)
  if [ -n "$INPUT" ]; then
    { printf '{"provider":"antigravity","hook_event_name":"%s","event":' "$1"; printf '%s' "$INPUT"; printf '}'; } |
      CLAXEDO_AGENT=antigravity bash "{{root}}/data/hooks/notify.sh" --harness=antigravity >/dev/null 2>&1
  fi
fi
# Observe lifecycle without injecting steps or asking the loop to continue.
printf '{}\n'
data/hooks/notify.sh:
#!/bin/bash
# Claxedo agent notification hook v1
# Forward provider JSON unchanged. The runtime owns normalization and state.
[ -z "$CLAXEDO_TAB_ID" ] && exit 0

# Every hook config Claxedo writes names the harness that owns it. Agents
# replay each other's configs (cursor-agent runs ~/.claude/settings.json) and
# run each other as tools (Claude's Bash launching `codex exec`); a config
# firing under a different agent than this terminal's is not this terminal's
# lifecycle.
HARNESS=""
case "${1:-}" in
  --harness=*) HARNESS="${1#--harness=}"; shift ;;
esac
AGENT="$CLAXEDO_AGENT"
case "$AGENT" in
  cursor-agent) AGENT="cursor" ;;
esac
if [ -n "$HARNESS" ]; then
  if [ -z "$AGENT" ]; then
    # No wrapper set the agent. Cursor stamps CURSOR_VERSION into every hook it
    # runs, including Claude's replayed config.
    if [ "$HARNESS" = "claude" ] && [ -n "$CURSOR_VERSION" ]; then exit 0; fi
    CLAXEDO_AGENT="$HARNESS"
  elif [ "$HARNESS" != "$AGENT" ]; then
    exit 0
  fi
fi

if [ -n "$1" ]; then
  INPUT="$1"
elif [ -t 0 ]; then
  exit 0
else
  INPUT=$(cat)
fi
[ -z "$INPUT" ] && exit 0

HOOK_PORT="${CLAXEDO_SERVER_PORT:-${CLAXEDO_PORT:-4312}}"
HOOK_URL="http://127.0.0.1:${HOOK_PORT}/api/wr/hook/agent-lifecycle"

# Complete delivery before returning to the provider. Failed requests must not
# consume a local settled-state marker and suppress a later delivery attempt.
curl -fsS "$HOOK_URL" \
  --request POST \
  --connect-timeout 1 \
  --max-time 2 \
  --header "x-workspace-id: $CLAXEDO_WORKSPACE_ID" \
  --header "Authorization: Bearer $CLAXEDO_AGENT_HOOK_TOKEN" \
  --data-urlencode "tabId=$CLAXEDO_TAB_ID" \
  --data-urlencode "terminalId=$CLAXEDO_TERMINAL_ID" \
  --data-urlencode "workspaceId=$CLAXEDO_WORKSPACE_ID" \
  --data-urlencode "provider=$CLAXEDO_AGENT" \
  --data-urlencode "providerEvent=$INPUT" \
  >/dev/null
data/bin/cline:
#!/bin/bash
# Claxedo agent-wrapper v1
# Claxedo wrapper for cline


find_real_binary() {
  local name="$1"
  local IFS=':'
  for dir in $PATH; do
    [ -z "$dir" ] && continue
    case "$dir" in
      "{{bin}}"|"$HOME/.workspace-runtime/bin") continue ;;
    esac
    if [ -x "$dir/$name" ] && [ ! -d "$dir/$name" ]; then
      printf "%s\n" "$dir/$name"
      return 0
    fi
  done
  return 1
}

REAL_BIN="$(find_real_binary "cline")"
if [ -z "$REAL_BIN" ]; then
  echo "Claxedo: cline not found in PATH. Install it and ensure it is on PATH, then retry." >&2
  exit 127
fi

export CLAXEDO_AGENT="cline"

if [ -n "${CLAXEDO_TAB_ID:-}" ]; then
  echo '{"hook_event_name":"Busy"}' | '{{root}}/data/hooks/notify.sh' 2>/dev/null &
fi

"$REAL_BIN" "$@"
EXIT_CODE=$?

if [ -n "${CLAXEDO_TAB_ID:-}" ]; then
  if [ $EXIT_CODE -ne 0 ]; then
    echo '{"hook_event_name":"Error"}' | '{{root}}/data/hooks/notify.sh' 2>/dev/null &
  else
    echo '{"hook_event_name":"Idle"}' | '{{root}}/data/hooks/notify.sh' 2>/dev/null &
  fi
fi

exit $EXIT_CODE

data/bin/copilot:
#!/bin/bash
# Claxedo agent-wrapper v1
# Claxedo wrapper for copilot


find_real_binary() {
  local name="$1"
  local IFS=':'
  for dir in $PATH; do
    [ -z "$dir" ] && continue
    case "$dir" in
      "{{bin}}"|"$HOME/.workspace-runtime/bin") continue ;;
    esac
    if [ -x "$dir/$name" ] && [ ! -d "$dir/$name" ]; then
      printf "%s\n" "$dir/$name"
      return 0
    fi
  done
  return 1
}

REAL_BIN="$(find_real_binary "copilot")"
if [ -z "$REAL_BIN" ]; then
  echo "Claxedo: copilot not found in PATH. Install it and ensure it is on PATH, then retry." >&2
  exit 127
fi

export CLAXEDO_AGENT="copilot"

# Copilot CLI only supports project-level hooks (.github/hooks/*.json in CWD).
# Auto-inject Claxedo notification hooks when running inside a Claxedo terminal.
if [ -n "$CLAXEDO_TAB_ID" ] && [ -f '{{root}}/data/hooks/copilot-hook.sh' ]; then
  COPILOT_HOOKS_DIR=".github/hooks"
  COPILOT_HOOK_FILE="$COPILOT_HOOKS_DIR/claxedo-notify.json"
  COPILOT_HOOKS='{
  "version": 1,
  "hooks": {
    "sessionStart": [
      {
        "type": "command",
        "bash": "bash '\''{{root}}/data/hooks/copilot-hook.sh'\'' sessionStart",
        "timeoutSec": 5
      }
    ],
    "sessionEnd": [
      {
        "type": "command",
        "bash": "bash '\''{{root}}/data/hooks/copilot-hook.sh'\'' sessionEnd",
        "timeoutSec": 5
      }
    ],
    "userPromptSubmitted": [
      {
        "type": "command",
        "bash": "bash '\''{{root}}/data/hooks/copilot-hook.sh'\'' userPromptSubmitted",
        "timeoutSec": 5
      }
    ],
    "postToolUse": [
      {
        "type": "command",
        "bash": "bash '\''{{root}}/data/hooks/copilot-hook.sh'\'' postToolUse",
        "timeoutSec": 5
      }
    ]
  }
}
'

  if [ "$(cat "$COPILOT_HOOK_FILE" 2>/dev/null)" != "$(printf '%s\n' "$COPILOT_HOOKS")" ]; then
    mkdir -p "$COPILOT_HOOKS_DIR" 2>/dev/null &&
      printf '%s\n' "$COPILOT_HOOKS" > "$COPILOT_HOOK_FILE.tmp.$$" 2>/dev/null &&
      mv -f "$COPILOT_HOOK_FILE.tmp.$$" "$COPILOT_HOOK_FILE" 2>/dev/null
  fi

  COPILOT_EXCLUDE=".git/info/exclude"
  if [ -d ".git/info" ] && ! grep -qxF ".github/hooks/claxedo-notify.json" "$COPILOT_EXCLUDE" 2>/dev/null; then
    # Never join the line onto a last entry the person left without a newline.
    [ -s "$COPILOT_EXCLUDE" ] && [ -n "$(tail -c 1 "$COPILOT_EXCLUDE")" ] && printf '\n' >> "$COPILOT_EXCLUDE"
    printf '%s\n' ".github/hooks/claxedo-notify.json" >> "$COPILOT_EXCLUDE" 2>/dev/null
  fi
fi

exec "$REAL_BIN" "$@"

#!/bin/bash
# Claxedo agent-wrapper v1
# Claxedo wrapper for claude


find_real_binary() {

  for dir in $PATH; do
    [ -z "$dir" ] && continue
    case "$dir" in
      "{{bin}}"|"$HOME/.workspace-runtime/bin") continue ;;
    esac
    if [ -x "$dir/$name" ] && [ ! -d "$dir/$name" ]; then
      printf "%s\n" "$dir/$name"
      return 0
    fi
  done
  return 1
}

REAL_BIN="$(find_real_binary "claude")"
if [ -z "$REAL_BIN" ]; then
  echo "Claxedo: claude not found in PATH. Install it and ensure it is on PATH, then retry." >&2
  exit 127
fi

export CLAXEDO_AGENT="claude"

# Ensure status is cleared even if Claude crashes, hits a limit, or is killed
cleanup() {
  EXIT_CODE=$?
  if [ "$EXIT_CODE" -eq 0 ]; then
    echo '{"hook_event_name":"Idle"}' | bash '{{root}}/data/hooks/notify.sh' >/dev/null 2>&1 &
  else
    echo '{"hook_event_name":"Error"}' | bash '{{root}}/data/hooks/notify.sh' >/dev/null 2>&1 &
  fi
}
trap cleanup EXIT

# Do not use exec here — exec replaces the shell process, which
# prevents the EXIT trap from firing.
"$REAL_BIN" --settings '{{root}}/data/hooks/claude-settings.json' "$@"

#!/bin/bash
# Claxedo agent-wrapper v1
# Claxedo wrapper for codex


find_real_binary() {
  local name="$1"
  local IFS=':'
  for dir in $PATH; do
    [ -z "$dir" ] && continue
    case "$dir" in
      "{{bin}}"|"$HOME/.workspace-runtime/bin") continue ;;
    esac
    if [ -x "$dir/$name" ] && [ ! -d "$dir/$name" ]; then
      printf "%s\n" "$dir/$name"
      return 0
    fi
  done
  return 1
}

REAL_BIN="$(find_real_binary "codex")"
if [ -z "$REAL_BIN" ]; then
  echo "Claxedo: codex not found in PATH. Install it and ensure it is on PATH, then retry." >&2
  exit 127
fi

export CLAXEDO_AGENT="codex"

# Inside a Claxedo tab, Codex runs Claxedo's lifecycle hooks from session flags,
# so no Codex config file is written. Codex skips hooks it has not trusted, and
# rejects the bypass flag when it is repeated.
if [ -n "${CLAXEDO_TAB_ID:-}" ]; then
  _claxedo_bypass="--dangerously-bypass-hook-trust"
  for _claxedo_arg in "$@"; do
    [ "$_claxedo_arg" = "--" ] && break
    if [ "$_claxedo_arg" = "--dangerously-bypass-hook-trust" ]; then
      _claxedo_bypass=""
      break
    fi
  done
  exec "$REAL_BIN" --enable hooks ${_claxedo_bypass:+"$_claxedo_bypass"} '-c' 'hooks.SessionStart=[{hooks=[{type="command",command="'\''{{root}}/data/hooks/notify.sh'\'' --harness=codex"}]}]' '-c' 'hooks.SessionEnd=[{hooks=[{type="command",command="'\''{{root}}/data/hooks/notify.sh'\'' --harness=codex"}]}]' '-c' 'hooks.UserPromptSubmit=[{hooks=[{type="command",command="'\''{{root}}/data/hooks/notify.sh'\'' --harness=codex"}]}]' '-c' 'hooks.PreToolUse=[{matcher="^request_user_input$",hooks=[{type="command",command="'\''{{root}}/data/hooks/notify.sh'\'' --harness=codex"}]}]' '-c' 'hooks.PostToolUse=[{matcher="*",hooks=[{type="command",command="'\''{{root}}/data/hooks/notify.sh'\'' --harness=codex"}]}]' '-c' 'hooks.PermissionRequest=[{hooks=[{type="command",command="'\''{{root}}/data/hooks/notify.sh'\'' --harness=codex"}]}]' '-c' 'hooks.Stop=[{hooks=[{type="command",command="'\''{{root}}/data/hooks/notify.sh'\'' --harness=codex"}]}]' '-c' 'hooks.Interrupt=[{hooks=[{type="command",command="'\''{{root}}/data/hooks/notify.sh'\'' --harness=codex"}]}]' '-c' 'hooks.SubagentStart=[{hooks=[{type="command",command="'\''{{root}}/data/hooks/notify.sh'\'' --harness=codex"}]}]' '-c' 'hooks.SubagentStop=[{hooks=[{type="command",command="'\''{{root}}/data/hooks/notify.sh'\'' --harness=codex"}]}]' "$@"
fi

exec "$REAL_BIN" "$@"
